Prashant Bhushan's 'Regime Change' Remark Sparks Political Row

Senior advocate Prashant Bhushan's statement suggesting a desire for "regime change" has triggered a political controversy. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) reacted strongly to Bhushan's remarks, with spokesperson Sambit Patra accusing the opposition of seeking to walk the path of "anarchy." The controversy also involves remarks made by Neha Bora. The BJP stated that "we all want a regime change," in response to Bhushan's comments.
